scope: Pre-AC1015 DXF DIMSTYLE DIMALTRND group-148 output

evidence.format_crosswalk: The current DIMSTYLE variable descriptor maps group 148 to DIMALTRND with minimum revision AC1015. Autodesk's AutoCAD 2007 DIMSTYLE table includes group 148; the archived R12 DIMSTYLE table does not. Autodesk system-variable reference documents DIMALTRND. The source model default is 0.0.

references.title: Autodesk AutoCAD Release 12 DXF Reference
references.observation: The listed group codes do not include group 148.

references.title: Autodesk D System Variables
references.observation: Documents DIMALTRND as the alternate dimension unit rounding setting.

evidence.code: dxfRW::writeDimstyle now refuses pre-AC1015 output when the typed dimaltrnd field or dynamic group-148 override is nonzero. The default zero remains omitted as before.
evidence.control: libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation generates typed and dynamic nonzero cases and verifies atomic refusal plus same-writer retry after restoring zero in ASCII and Binary AC1014; it also checks that clean ASCII R14 DIMSTYLE output has no group 148.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated controls write only to the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: The version threshold follows the existing project descriptor and is not independently stated in the cited Autodesk group-code table.
This does not qualify other DIMSTYLE downgrade fields or consumer rendering semantics.
